phase_name: Tomato & Rice Disease AI Integration with Crop Monitoring
verdict: PHASE F5D-3 VERIFIED — READY FOR F5D-4

ai_models_integrated.research_caveat: Trained on open-access research benchmark datasets (PlantDoc). Laboratory classification is not clinical certification.
Deep learning vision model for academic and experimental advisory. Always consult your Upazila Agriculture Officer (SAAO).

endpoints: GET /api/cultivation/crops/{crop_id}/disease-model (checks crop-to-model compatibility & returns classes + caveats)
POST /api/cultivation/observations/{observation_id}/link-prediction (links audited prediction record to crop observation)
backend_deliverables.matching_logic: Canonical token parsing rejecting arbitrary substring matches (e.g. wheat, potato, mustard correctly flagged unsupported)
backend_deliverables.cross_user_isolation: Strictly enforced ownership checks on farm, crop, observation, and prediction records
backend_deliverables.scientific_integrity: Linking predictions preserves farmer_reported_condition and never mutates calendar tasks

frontend_deliverables.supported_crop_view: Model banner, supported classes, research caveat, dropzone, synthetic leaf generator, preview, analyze button
frontend_deliverables.unsupported_crop_view: Clear amber warning card explaining lack of vision model for other crops with navigation to regular scouting
frontend_deliverables.result_card: Predicted disease in Bangla/English, uncalibrated confidence score badge, full class probability breakdown, linking actions
frontend_deliverables.linking_features: Link to existing observation, create new observation with prediction attached, unlink button on observation items
